content.title: BlackBerry lifts lower end of annual revenue forecast on cybersecurity demand
content.summary: BlackBerry on Thursday raised the lower end of its fiscal ​2026 revenue forecast, signalling strong demand for ‌its cybersecurity software as companies ramp up spending to ‌counter increasingly sophisticated cyber attacks. This comes as rising digital threats and the growing complexity of AI-driven breaches are fueling demand for security ⁠solutions, benefiting firms ‌like BlackBerry that have pivoted from hardware to software and services. The company ‍now sees annual revenue between $531 million and $541 million, compared with its prior expectations of $519 million and $541 million.

content.title: BlackBerry: Fiscal Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: WATERLOO, Ontario (AP) — BlackBerry Ltd. (BB) on Thursday reported fiscal third-quarter net income of $13.7 million, after reporting a loss in the same period a year earlier. On a per-share basis, the Waterloo, Ontario-based company said it had net income of 2 cents. Earnings, adjusted for stock option expense and restructuring costs, came to 5 cents per share.
